Buy Now Pay Later became a regulated product today — here's what that means for your money. 🌿

From 15 July 2026, the FCA regulates interest-free BNPL (deferred payment credit: 12 or fewer instalments over 12 months or less). For new agreements from today, lenders must:
• Check you can afford to repay — before you borrow
• Tell you the amount, repayment dates and any late fees upfront
• Contact you, explain and offer support if you miss a payment
• Give you the right to take complaints to the Financial Ombudsman Service

And Section 75 refund protection now applies — the same cover you'd have paying by credit card.

One budget action: BNPL instalments are bills. List every one on your Fixed Expenses page with its due date, so the next payment never ambushes payday.

Source: FCA (fca.org.uk), 15 July 2026.
